title: I can't believe the podcast I learned to code with is back!
why_read: A personal nostalgia post about a podcast relaunch, containing no technical substance.
analysis: This post is a personal reflection from the new CodeNewbie Podcast host about how the podcast helped her during her own coding bootcamp journey, paired with a season announcement and TikTok link. It is purely narrative and promotional, with zero technical content relevant to engineering practice. It has no real place in a digest focused on technical interest beyond community color.
